verdict.rationale: Bolt lets users push/export their project's code to a GitHub repository and edit code directly, which is an open, portable format (bolt-docs-2, bolt-docs-4, bolt-docs-17, bolt-docs-30). However, this only covers source code — there's no documented mechanism to export other project data (chat history, tokens usage, Supabase/Stripe configs, collaboration state) in an open format, and backend data lives in tied third-party services like Supabase (bolt-comm-11). Missing for 10: full account/data export beyond code, documentation of exporting non-code project state, independent verification that GitHub export captures 100% of project fidelity.
